title: YESTERDAY, TOMORROW
protagonist: Andries "Dries" Venter — systems architect, Technopark, Stellenbosch. Close third throughout.
logline: An engineer proves the past leaves a readable physical residue, then finds the same machine already computing tomorrow from constraints nobody can see — with eleven months to stop a collapse that has no single cause and is being prevented by the thing causing it.
setting: 2030–34 — Technopark Stellenbosch · the Karoo · Accra–Kumasi · Nairobi · a SANAP-linked Antarctic station
sensitivity_read: REQUIRED — composite apartheid-era disappearance (historian/legal review, victim-family sensitivity, composite by construction); Ghana and Kenya technical/cultural readers; SANAP operational review; 420 Code terminology review by G; Lucid architecture review by AJ/G; quant read on the catastrophe model; cryptography/provenance review
notes: Single novel. Retitled 2026-08-19 from ONE RECORD (L-01); 'the One Record' remains the in-world corpus term per L-27. Structure in canon/STRUCTURE.md, spine in canon/PLOT.md, Court in canon/LUCID_COURT.md. Two-book blueprints preserved in archive/.
